# fethr

> fethr is a featherweight code editor with first-class AI agent integration,
> currently under construction. The name is pronounced "feather".

## What it is

- A minimal, fast desktop code editor where an AI coding agent is a first-class
  peer process, not a bolted-on extension: the editor forwards context
  (selection, files, project) and renders results (streams, diffs); the
  intelligence lives in the agent runtime.
- Designed around the front-end/runtime split popularized by Claude Code.
  fethr is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
- No extension platform by design: language intelligence via LSP, syntax via
  tree-sitter, agent via its own protocol.

## Status

Pre-alpha. The npm package (`npx fethr`) is a placeholder CLI; there is no
editor to run yet.
